summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-1 defeat against New Mills in a frustrating encounter where they conceded set-piece goals and were undone by an awkward bounce late in the game. Despite some promising moments and chances created, The Bach couldn't find the cutting edge when it mattered, though they'll look to bounce back quickly with a home Vase fixture against Ashby Ivanhoe on Saturday before a trip to Market Drayton on Tuesday.
